# Sumanth Chary

## What he builds (fixed price, quoted in writing after one call)
- Landing page that sells — from ₹18,000, typically 5–7 days
- Online store (custom storefront, Shopify backend) — from ₹45,000, typically 2–3 weeks
- AI product or automation (working v1 with auth, payments, AI) — from ₹75,000, typically 3–5 weeks

## Work (each has a case study)
- PostPro AI — LinkedIn voice-matching writer, live: https://postproai.app — https://sumanthdev.me/work/postpro-ai
- Galley Resume — resume builder with one template on purpose and an AI that edits it with you; free ATS check; free to try, $9 once or $29 for life — https://sumanthdev.me/work/galley-resume
- FlipScan AI — sneaker resale price estimator for US resellers, early users — https://sumanthdev.me/work/flipscan-ai
- LegalDeep AI — AI contract analyzer, founded, built and sold — acquired by Darren Gill on 11 October 2026; the sale was announced publicly (links on the case study) — https://sumanthdev.me/work/legaldeep-ai
- AirWrite — hand-tracking drawing app (MediaPipe HandLandmarker): raise your index finger at the webcam and draw in the air; One Euro filter smoothing, hover-to-click UI, PNG export and recording; runs in the browser, nothing uploaded; open source: https://github.com/SumanthChary/airwrite — https://sumanthdev.me/work/airwrite
- Sri Vastrika — custom storefront for an Indian nighties & sarees label, live: https://srivastrika.store — https://sumanthdev.me/work/sri-vastrika
